facts.fact: A BCEAO communiqué of 25 June 2026 set 30 September 2026 as the deadline for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions in the UEMOA to connect to the PI-SPI instant payment platform (30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions); Burkina Faso is a UEMOA member and had 13 authorised institutions on the platform at 31 July 2026, per Finance SAO.
